symbols.name: RotaryEncoderV2::update
symbols.prototype: void RotaryEncoderV2::update(RotaryEncoderV2 *this, int phase, unsigned now)
evidence: RotaryEncoderV2 vtable slot 0. Object: +4 index, +8 RotaryEncoderDelegate *, +12 last phase, +16 direction state, +28 time of the last rest position, +32 armed flag. Phase 3 (rest) clears the state and records now in +28; the first change after it sets the direction (phase 1 -> state 2, phase 2 -> state 1) and arms; the next change fires once and disarms: one report per detent, not every 16 calls.

Step size: dt = now - (+28); if now >= (+28) (no wrap) and dt/2 < 9 the step is g_encoder_accel_table[dt/2] (12, 10, 8, 6, 5, 4, 3, 2, 1), else 1; negated for state 2. now is tick_count() (0xC2617CC0) from the input poll. So fast turns move up to 12 per detent; SmplTrek 3.2.174 has no such acceleration.

Output differs from Lofi-12 XT's copy: instead of the step it passes a pointer to a static message (g_rotary_encoder_message, one-time initialised behind a guard byte at B14+260) whose halfword +0 is set to the step: delegate slot 0 (delegate, this, index, &msg). This matches CyDrums pages taking handleRotaryEncoderMessage(RotaryEncoderMessage const&); the other message fields (+2 = 1, +3 = 0, +4 = 0 at initialisation) are not interpreted.

symbols.name: MIDI::MIDIInputPort::handle_channel_message
evidence: Read in Ghidra's listing (objdump's lines here carry spurious '|| nop 5' tails but the same instructions), delay slots followed packet by packet. Returns if the delegate (+8) is null. On msg[0] & 0xF0: 0x80 -> delegate slot 0; 0x90 -> slot 1, or with velocity 0 slot 0 with a stack copy whose status is 0x80 | channel; 0xB0 -> slot 2; 0xC0 -> slot 3; 0xE0 -> slot 5; 0xD0 -> slot 4 (corrected 2026-11-10, see below); 0xA0 dropped. Each call is (delegate, this, msg).

Differs from SmplTrek / Lofi-12 XT (pitch bend there is slot 4, channel pressure dropped): CyDrums' MIDIInputPortDelegate has nine slots, channel pressure goes to slot 4, and MIDIInputPort slots 1 / 2 / 3 forward to delegate slots 6 (system common) / 8 (SysEx) / 7 (single byte) instead of 5 / 7 / 6.

Correction 2026-11-10: 0xDn reaches slot 4. At 0xC25A7D64 the branch to 0xC25A7E00 (status > 0xC0) is issued with b0 = (status == 0xD0) set in the same packet; inside its delay slots 0xC25A7D9C issues [b0] b 0xC25A7EB0, which lands after 0xC25A7E00-0xC25A7E20 and loads vtable +16 (slot 4) with A4 = delegate, B4 = port, A6 = msg. The earlier reading missed the second branch. SmplTrek's dispatcher (0xC1662180) has no 0xD0 compare, so SmplTrek and Lofi-12 XT do drop channel pressure.
